name: bitbattle-workspace
description: BitBattle - Real Time Multiplayer Coding & Quiz Contest Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue.bold,cyan.bold" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
